about_the_game:
writhing through the digital abyss, the cyber serpent musn't miss...
snake meets twin-stick shooter. slither and shoot your way through endless waves of polygonal enemies for a high score in this modern take on retro classics.

key_features
  • classic snake gameplay with a modern twin-stick twist.
  • left stick to move, right stick to shoot. also works with keyboard and mouse.
  • infinite mode with online leaderboard.
  • challenge mode with 30 curated waves and a boss fight.
  • pulsating lights set to 90's electronica.
  • retro-inspired wireframe graphics.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.12 (Sierra) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Graphics 6100 or equivalent
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.14 (Mojave) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card with 4 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: slither and shoot, but don't run out of space! cyber_serpent is an arcade twin-stick shooter combined with snake. compete for a global high score in this modern take on retro classics as you face infinite waves of polygonal enemies.
